record.title: Intermittent Metric Write Errors in GCP US Central (prod-us-central-0)

updates.body: Between 15:31 and 20:43 UTC on September 14, 2026 (approximately 5 hours 12 minutes), some customers in GCP US Central (prod-us-central-0) may have experienced intermittent errors or delays when writing metrics. This has been fully resolved and all services are operating normally.
